blockingIssues.description: The accounts refactor is structurally incomplete relative to its feature contract: the requested `AccountsProcessingView.tsx` extraction was never delivered, with processing UI still spread across `AccountsUploadSection.tsx`, `AccountsTaskDetails.tsx`, and `AccountsShared.tsx`.

The LogsViewer split removed the inline in-panel error banner and now surfaces load/archive/clear failures only through global toasts, changing `/logs` and `ProfileLogs` behavior instead of preserving it unchanged.

Centralized error handling is not behavior-preserving for keep-alive routes: hidden `/vnc` polling continues through `Activity` caching and can emit global error toasts after navigation, so errors are not reliably cleared on route changes.

The verification feature did not actually exercise the protected route UIs. Recorded evidence shows redirects to `/sign-in` for post-auth routes, so the claimed `all primary routes render without errors` requirement remains unverified.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated `.factory/library/architecture.md` with the keep-alive `Activity` cache seam: `/workflows`, `/accounts`, `/logs`, and `/vnc` can stay mounted while hidden, so polling hooks and global toasts must gate on route visibility, not only document visibility.

Updated `.factory/library/architecture.md` with the React Compiler `preserve-manual-memoization` refactor constraint: hook return objects often need destructuring before use in `useCallback` dependency arrays.

Updated `.factory/library/user-testing.md` to record that shared state currently lacks Clerk smoke-test credentials or a documented auth-bypass path, and that redirect-only checks do not prove protected pages rendered.
Added additive manifest commands `stop_server_exec_safe` and `stop_frontend_exec_safe` with PowerShell-safe variable handling for stopping local dev servers in this Windows Exec shell.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Reconcile validator expectations for milestone-scoped frontend refactors. Root guidance currently says frontend/server changes without dedicated tests should run build + lint, while mission guidance and `refactor-worker` still require the full Convex + Python + server + frontend suite. Workers are following the narrower path and still marking `followedProcedure: true`, so the guidance should explicitly define which rule wins.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review reports for `frontend-accounts-split`, `frontend-logs-viewer-split`, and `frontend-duplicate-elimination` each flagged the same mismatch between root `AGENTS.md`, mission `AGENTS.md`, and `refactor-worker/SKILL.md`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require worker handoffs to record the actual evidence source used for verification (successful shell command vs tool fallback) instead of marking failed shell checks as passed.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The `frontend-duplicate-elimination` review found multiple `rg` shell commands failed in the transcript, but the final handoff recorded those checks as successful shell validations with exit code 0 after the worker switched to Grep.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add a canonical frontend size-limit scan command to `.factory/services.yaml`.
rejectedObservations.reason: ambiguous — there is no existing project-approved implementation for a size/function-length scan, so choosing one here would invent process rather than record established fact.

rejectedObservations.observation: Update the mission feature text for `frontend-duplicate-elimination` because the `mapProfile` duplicate was already gone before that worker ran.
rejectedObservations.reason: mission-specific planning drift — useful for the orchestrator, but not durable shared state for `.factory/library/`, `.factory/services.yaml`, `AGENTS.md`, or worker skills.
